Subject: SIG questionnaire initiation - AcmeHealth (clarifying questions)

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time to chat today. As discussed, we're ready to kick off the vendor security questionnaire so your security team can complete the SIG/CAIQ items. I've attached our SIG template and a short CAIQ export to make the process quicker.

Quick clarifying questions so we can route answers correctly and give you an accurate timeline:
- SOC 2: Do you need a current SOC 2 Type II report, or will a redacted report suffice? (We can provide the redacted report under NDA.)
- HIPAA: Will you require a signed BAA prior to taking any production data, or is the questionnaire the first step?
- Data residency: Are you constrained to US-only hosting, or do you need EU/APAC region attestations?
- Log retention / access: Any specific retention window (e.g., 90/180/365 days) we should call out in responses?
- Timeline: What is your target completion date? Typical turnaround from our side for filled SIGs is ~7–10 business days once we have the completed spreadsheet and any follow-up asks.

Next steps I propose: I’ll attach the SIG template here — if you can drop the completed sheet into the secure upload link (or reply with it), we'll triage answers and loop in Marissa (our security lead) for any engineering-level details. If any questions require architecture diagrams or sample configs, we can provide those as separate attachments.

Attachments: redwood_SIG_template.xlsx, redwood_CAIQ_short.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the finish line.

Best,
Camila Reyes

Hey Camila —

Appreciate the follow-up and the templates. A few quick answers/questions from our side:
- SOC 2: We require a full Type II report for vendors in our critical-data tier; a redacted report is acceptable for initial review but the team will likely request the full report under NDA later in the cycle.
- HIPAA: Yes — we will need a BAA in place before any PHI is transmitted.
- Data residency: US-only for now.
- Retention: 90 days is our standard, but we can be flexible depending on the data class.

Two asks: 1) Does Redwood need access to our environment to answer any SIG items, or can everything be answered from your side? 2) Can you share a secure upload link for the completed spreadsheet (we prefer not to email forms back and forth)?

We'd like to aim to have the filled questionnaire back to you in ~2 weeks — does that timeline work?

Thanks,
Jordan
Security Manager | AcmeHealth
jordan.miller@acmehealth.com

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks for the quick responses — that timeline works. To answer your questions:
1) No access to your environment is required for the majority of SIG/CAIQ items. Most questions are about policies, controls, and evidence (e.g., policy docs, screenshots, redacted reports). If engineering-level details are requested, Marissa (cc'd) can coordinate with your engineer(s) for specific artifacts or short Q&A sessions — we can keep those scoped and timeboxed.
2) Secure upload: please use the link below to upload the completed SIG spreadsheet and any supporting artifacts. The link is encrypted and is routed to our security team folder for the AcmeHealth deal.

Secure upload: https://secure-upload.example.com/acmehealth/rfp-uploads

A couple of clarifications from our side that will help speed review:
- For SOC 2, if you can mark which controls are in-scope for the Type II report it helps us map evidence quickly.
- If you need a redacted SOC 2 now, we can provide it within 24 hours after a simple NDA — happy to send the DocuSign if you want to proceed.
- For the BAA, we have a standard template; if AcmeHealth needs custom language we can route that to legal, but that will add time to the timeline.

We'll plan to start our internal triage once the completed sheet is uploaded. If anything comes up that requires engineering input we'll ask for a 30-minute sync and limit it to a defined set of questions.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the DocuSign NDA link if you want the redacted SOC 2 today.

Best,
